elements.label: Whole app UI: page swaps from the Impact vs. Effort chart to the new list view, then the frame pushes in toward the top-left
View title input 'New View' (focused, blue outline)

pattern.description: The screen recording switches instantly to the newly created list view. A post-production camera push-in (about 1.16x, drifting toward the top-left) then frames the focused 'New View' title field and the idea table, as the narrator says 'give the head of sales'.
pattern.why_premium: The push-in turns an ordinary page change into a guided moment: it crops away the browser chrome and sidebar and makes the field the user is about to rename larger. The decelerating zoom keeps the recording feeling directed rather than raw.

build_hint.gsap: Hard swap the screenshot layers (set autoAlpha), then gsap.fromTo('.screen', {scale: 1, xPercent: 0}, {scale: 1.16, xPercent: 4, transformOrigin: '15% 10%', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: On the swap frame, change the source. Then scale = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - swapFrame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}), [0, 1], [1, 1.16]) with transformOrigin '15% 10%' and a matching translateX for the drift.

notes: The energy curve shows a cut-like spike (page swap) followed by a sustained decaying burst (zoom). Camera verdict is push_in with a scale of about 1.16. The final pan_x of -0.086 means content moves left in pixel terms; the label 'slide_right' is ambiguous, since the framing travels toward the left edge. The TS-2 row highlight was already present and is not listed.
